content: Injections themselves are not the primary focus; however, it is essential to monitor the patient for 10 minutes following the administration of an injection to observe for any adverse effects related to the procedure. Adding plans to your system allows for a comparison of the formulary status of a drug with other medications within the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. By adding plans, you gain the ability to compare and analyze formulary details effectively. The information provided is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. It is important to note that individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
